```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
medit_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(RELMEDYR != 0) |>
  select(RELMEDYR)

p_medit <- ggplot(medit_df, aes(factor(RELMEDYR, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#FFCF4F", color = "#A38433",stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to RELMEDYR", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to RELMEDYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, did you use meditation?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
medit_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(RELMEDPAIN != 0) |>
  select(RELMEDPAIN)

p_med_pain <- ggplot(medit_pain_df, aes(factor(RELMEDPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#FF9B3D", color = "#A36327", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to RELMEDPAIN", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4500)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to RELMEDYR", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "In the past 12 months have you practiced meditation for pain?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    #plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )

p_medit + p_med_pain
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
medt_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$RELMEDYR, 2)
medt_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$RELMEDYR, 1)

med_yes_per <- round((medt_yes/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)
med_no_per <- round((medt_no/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)

# 17.963 % of adults in our sample have answered 'yes' to having done meditation
# in the past 12 months 
```
RELMEDYR: *"During the past 12 months, did you use meditation?"*\
Yes: `r medt_yes`, (`r med_yes_per`%)\
No: `r medt_no`, (`r med_no_per`%)\

```{r, echo=FALSE}

medt_pain_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$RELMEDPAIN, 2)
medt_pain_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$RELMEDPAIN, 1)

#yes n = 931
#no n = 4032

med_pain_per <- round((medt_pain_yes / medt_yes)*100, 2)
med_pain_no <- round((medt_pain_no/ medt_yes)*100, 2)

# 18.74 % of the 4967 people who answered yes to having practiced meditation 
# in the past 12 months reported practicing meditation for pain. 
```
RELMEDPAIN: *in the past 12 months have you practiced meditation for pain?*\
Yes: `r medt_pain_yes`, (`r med_yes_per`%)\
No: `r medt_pain_no`, (`r med_no_per`%)\
